name: routed-review
_comment: classify-and-act + adversarial verification. A small diff gets one quick pass; a large or risky one triggers a full audit across three lenses. The classification is the model's; the routing is code, so the same diff always takes the same path.

nodes.prompt:
Here is a change to review:
{{task}}

Decide the depth of review it deserves.
- Mechanical, small, or confined to tests/docs -> quick
- Touches auth, money, data migration, public API, or is large -> audit
